user_query: My company is developing a voice-activated assistant that can spell out numbers in different languages. We need an API that can convert numbers to spelled-out format using the specified language and rule set.

TaskList.description: Research available APIs for converting numbers to spelled-out format in multiple languages.
Evaluate the functionality of the APIs found to ensure they meet language and rule set specifications.
Select the best API based on evaluation criteria (performance, coverage of languages, ease of integration).
Integrate the selected API into the voice-activated assistant application.
